comment: Read by markdown-link-check via checklist-markdown. That tool does NOT
auto-discover this file; the checklist passes --config explicitly, but
only when the file exists, so deleting it restores the unconfigured
default rather than breaking the hook.
This file is for links no CI can resolve, not for links that are merely
comment_gitlab: gitlab.alpinelinux.org is ignored for THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md's generated
inventory: one aports source-tree link per bundled package, pinned to the
aports commit apk's own database records for it. A link checker adds
nothing to those: scripts/generate-third-party-licenses.py writes them
from that database, so a typo is impossible, and a path at a pinned commit
cannot be renamed under them; --check against a fresh build is what
catches a stale inventory. What the checker did catch was the host:
it answered bursts with 418, and from 2026-10-28 it stopped answering at
all for more than a day (connections to both its old and new address
timed out), which failed every pull request in this repository while
